about: Visual validation of the v4.6 relabelling by eye (2026-11-25), after E started training. Samples from MobileAgent-SFT-v4.6 @ 0ace5559 train shards 3 and 21 and the AndroidControl test split.

counterfactual_rows.notes: stale x3: the pending step is still on screen (Move button, Remove dialog, Delete menu) and the label redoes it; ahead x3: the label is the action the shown screen needs; short x3: the final screen shows the goal done (filters applied, alarm sound set, font 113%)

new_rule_unchanged_pairs.notes: all 0.0000% changed pixels; 76 of 8,444 non-wait AndroidControl test pairs are flagged unchanged

wait_intent_relabels.notes: the intent now matches the action; 4 waits sit on loaded screens where a real next action was obvious: an AndroidControl action-label problem, not fixed in v4.6 (round 9: tied to the looping failure)

judges: see manual_terminal_review.json (stage 1: 21/24 agreement) and contradicts_review.json (stage 2: about 6 right / 7 wrong / 3 ambiguous of 16)

kept_no_proof_complete_rows.notes: mostly 'share via email' tasks: the app returns to the shared item, so only the history can show the send step

intent_wording.notes: mismatches name a nearby element (a 'Skip' label on an X tap, an avatar on a copy-link tap); actions are the humans' real taps

androidcontrol_wait_actions.notes: loaded pages, dialogs needing a tap, and waits right after a confirmation toast where the next step is complete; about 43% of ~6,600 wait rows; present since v1; round-9 fix: drop waits whose next screen is unchanged (train/screen_change.py), judge the rest for a loading state

correction_2026_11_25.status: the 43% estimate above is WRONG: it was judged from the wait screen alone, without the next screen
correction_2026_11_25.method: before/after pairs (screen at the wait | the episode's next screen), analysis/done_audit/wait_audit.py samples, 40 random pairs (16 + 24, seed 91)

next_screen_changed_or_status_next.notes: justified: spinner or skeleton -> content, 'Saving...' -> saved, a toast or overlay disappears; unneeded: results already on screen before `complete`; unclear: a text field cleared

next_screen_unchanged.notes: pixel-identical screens, then the human acts: the wait did nothing

correction_2026_11_25.full_counts: analysis/done_audit/wait_detail.py on the v4.6 train split: 64 waits followed by an action on the unchanged screen (relabelled in v4.7), 24 followed by another wait on a static screen (kept), the rest changed
correction_2026_11_25.conclusion: the AndroidControl wait labels are mostly right; the looping comes from the agent, which never sees that a wait changed nothing (docs/PREREG_v47.md)
